categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Longda Superalloy Co., Ltd. focuses on the research, production, and sales of high-temperature superalloys and alloy materials. Its main product lines include cast high-temperature superalloys, wrought high-temperature superalloys, and alloy tubes such as copper-nickel alloy tubes and high-speed rail grounding alloy tubes. These products serve key industries including aerospace, energy power, oil and petrochemical, shipbuilding, automotive, and rail transit, with a particular focus on aviation engines and gas turbines (referred to as 'two machines').
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed advanced technologies such as ultra-high purity smelting, Re-containing single crystal superalloy smelting, low-temperature refining, direct casting, and triple melting processes (vacuum induction + electroslag remelting + vacuum consumable electrode remelting). It also employs multi-stage homogenization, multi-batch customized fine-grain forging, and rapid pre-furnace analysis technologies. The company has established a standardized testing system certified by CNAS and NADCAP, enabling precise detection of over 70 elements in superalloys. It also utilizes advanced equipment like vacuum induction furnaces, vacuum consumable electrode furnaces, and high-frequency intelligent forging machines.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's primary customers are leading domestic and international aerospace engine manufacturers, gas turbine producers, and oil and gas service companies. Key clients include China Aviation Engine Group, Rolls-Royce, Safran, Honeywell, Collins Aerospace, Siemens, Baker Hughes, and Halliburton. The products are used in critical components such as turbine blades, turbine disks, combustion chambers, and compressor disks in military and civil aviation engines, heavy-duty gas turbines, and oil and gas drilling equipment. The company also supplies materials for 3D printing applications in aerospace.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with its headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province. It has expanded its international market presence by supplying global aerospace and gas turbine manufacturers, including customers in Europe, the United States, and Asia-Pacific regions. International clients include Rolls-Royce, Safran, Honeywell, Collins Aerospace, Siemens, and Baker Hughes.
categories.supply_chain_position: Longda operates primarily upstream and midstream in the supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of high-performance alloy materials and superalloys. It produces raw and semi-finished alloy materials such as cast and wrought superalloys and alloy tubes, which are then supplied to downstream manufacturers of aerospace engines, gas turbines, and other high-end equipment components.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and R&D to support national strategic needs in aerospace and energy sectors. It undertakes major national projects related to aviation engines and gas turbines, focusing on developing advanced superalloys with improved purity, low segregation, and enhanced mechanical properties. R&D efforts include developing new alloy grades, recycling technologies for returned materials, and manufacturing processes for large-size and complex-shaped components. The company also collaborates with research institutes like Suzhou Laboratory to build joint innovation platforms.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of alloy products, including high-temperature superalloys and alloy tubes, directly to industrial customers and through distributors. The company follows a 'sales-driven production' model, producing according to customer orders and maintaining reasonable inventory levels for military products. It also benefits from government subsidies and grants related to R&D and industry development.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Longda is positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer of aviation-grade cast and wrought high-temperature superalloys and alloy tubes, recognized as a national specialized and innovative 'little giant' enterprise. It competes with both domestic and international suppliers in the aerospace and energy materials sectors. The company has achieved certifications and supply qualifications with major global aerospace engine manufacturers, indicating a strong competitive position in the high-end superalloy market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.21 billion, a 26.91% increase year-over-year, driven by growth in high-temperature superalloy sales. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 55.38 million, a 41.36% decrease due to raw material price fluctuations and increased R&D and verification expenses. Total assets reached RMB 3.36 billion, up 5.93%, with net assets of RMB 2.78 billion. The company maintains a stable financial position with ongoing investments in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Longda emphasizes its advanced technological capabilities, including ultra-high purity and low segregation superalloy production, and comprehensive quality control systems certified by international aerospace standards. Its products are widely used in critical aerospace engine components, gas turbines, and other high-end applications, offering superior performance in high-temperature, high-stress environments. The company’s integration of R&D, production, and testing capabilities, along with strategic partnerships with leading domestic and international customers, differentiates it as a reliable supplier of core materials for strategic industries.
